title: Import confirmation with preview, safety backup and exportedAt
findings_note: TrackerViewModel.kt:85-100 and TrackerRepository.kt:138-184 (import wipes all data as soon as a file is picked)
boundary: **Not in this slice:** encrypting backups (a later item), merging instead of replacing, and the export side (S43).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
- Importing replaces all data the moment the user picks a file. There is no preview and no way back if it was the wrong file.
- The backup records no date, so the user cannot tell which backup they picked.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
JVM:
- `exportedAt round-trips through encode and decode`
- `decode of a backup without exportedAt gives null`
- `prune keeps the newest three safety backups by file name` (in `BackupFilesTest`, with a `TemporaryFolder`)

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. `BackupCodec.encode(bundles, exportedAtEpochMs: Long? = null)` writes `exportedAtEpochMs` at the top level when given. `decode` reads it as optional into `ImportPayload.exportedAtEpochMs: Long?`. The format version stays 1. Production export passes `System.currentTimeMillis()`.
2. `BackupFiles.prune(dir: File, keep: Int = 3)` deletes all but the newest `keep` files named `pre-import-*.json`, sorted by name (names contain a sortable timestamp).
3. ViewModel: `prepareImport(context, uri)` reads the file on `Dispatchers.IO` (refuse anything over 20 MB with "That file is too large to be a backup.") and decodes it on `Dispatchers.Default`. On success it sets `pendingImport` (a `StateFlow<PendingImport?>` holding the raw text, tracker count, active entry count and exported date). A `BackupFormatException` shows its message and sets nothing.
4. `MainScreen` shows an `AlertDialog` when `pendingImport != null`: "Replace all data? This backup has {N} trackers and {M} entries (exported {date}). Your current {N'} trackers will be removed." The current tracker count comes from a new DAO query `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trackers`. Buttons are "Replace" (destructive colour) and "Cancel". Cancel clears `pendingImport` and touches nothing.
5. `confirmImport()`: if the database has any trackers, first write the current data with `BackupCodec.encode` to `filesDir/backups/pre-import-yyyyMMdd-HHmmss.json` on IO, then call `BackupFiles.prune`. If writing the safety copy fails, stop and show an error without importing. Then cancel the existing reminders (S08's `cancelAll`), run `repository.importBackup(raw)`, reschedule reminders, and show "Backup imported. A copy of your previous data was saved in the app's private storage."
6. Do not change what `importBackup` does inside its transaction.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest` passes.
- Manual: pick a backup and the dialog shows the right counts and date, and Cancel changes nothing. Replace imports it, and a `pre-import-*.json` file appears under `files/backups` (debug build, `run-as`). After four imports only the newest three remain. A non-backup file shows the format error and nothing is replaced.
